source.name: sports.ru: Olimpbet продлил контракт с хоккейным «Спартаком» до 2027 года
source.quote: Olimpbet продлил контракт с хоккейным «Спартаком» до 2027 года
source.note: Russian: Olimpbet extended its HC Spartak contract through end of season 2026/27 (a two-season agreement). Sleeve placement: white OLIMPBET tapes above the sleeve numbers are visible on the red 2026-27 home sweater in the club's own match photos (spartak.ru reports: Spartak–Traktor 2026-09-30, /news/spartak-ne-uderzhal-pobednyij-schyot-v-igre-s-traktorom-24/, photo sd-cr-spartak-traktor-0001763.jpg; Spartak–Avtomobilist 2026-09-26, photo 6m1a9117.jpg). The same photos also show OLIMPBET stickers on the pants front and helmet sides (no schema placement) and the KHL league-level marks — the Mir chest patch and the SOGAZ helmet sticker — recorded as league deals in data/deals/khl-mir-nspk.json and khl-sogaz.json. No text source names the sleeve position.

summary: 2026-27 home kit (red, Jogel is the technical partner). The front carries only the «Спартак» wordmark with KHL and 80th-anniversary club patches, per the official shop's 2026-27 game-sweater product photos; on-ice match photos from the club site (Traktor 2026-09-30, Avtomobilist 2026-09-26, Metallurg 2026-10-02) show OLIMPBET tapes on the sleeves plus OLIMPBET stickers on the pants and helmets (no schema placement), and the league-level Mir chest patch and SOGAZ helmet sticker (covered by data/deals/khl-mir-nspk.json and khl-sogaz.json). Komus is a club partner per the club partners page. Not marked complete: minor placements such as socks could not be verified, and the club's partners page lists further partners (Jogel, Azbuka Vkusa, Yandex Afisha, Yandex Pro, Pinsky & Co, Chernogolovka, Forge, Synergetic, Bionova, Nebo, Solntse Moskvy, Britva Barbershop, Herbarus, Plaza Garden, Sofi) not yet individually recorded.
